text: A dating show has 6 boys and 6 girls, and every boy goes on one date with every girl. How many dates is that?
why: Each of the 6 boys has 6 dates: 6 × 6 = 36.

text: A Big Brother series starts with 16 housemates. One is evicted each week and nobody new arrives. After how many weeks are only 2 left?
why: 14 have to go, at one a week.
